original.target_description: Main experiment: Binary gambling risk-taking choice, high-power versus low-power poses.

n.exclusions: No risk-taking exclusions reported; N = 42 explicitly belongs to the critical test.

notes: Identity verified from supplied complete six-page Research Report: Power Posing: Brief Nonverbal Displays Affect Neuroendocrine Levels and Risk Tolerance; Dana R. Carney, Amy J.C. Cuddy, and Andy J. Yap; Psychological Science 21(10), 1363–1368; DOI 10.1177/0956797610383437. Primary original report, not the Ranehill replication. No PDF supplied. Study 1 and named outcomes identify the main experiment; the additional study (N = 49) on p.1367 is excluded. Numerical main results are on printed p.1366 (document page 4), rather than supplied locator p.5. Analytic participant N is explicitly printed in the chi-square test for the main experiment gambling choice. Requested printed chi-square statistic retained; the same test also prints Φ = .30. No effect-size conversions performed. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
